stem.text: An enzyme was added to a small excess of its substrate. All variables were kept constant.
A student was asked to sketch a graph to show how the concentration of the enzyme-substrate complex changes over time.

A.alt: Graph of concentration against time; the curve rises to a peak and then falls.

B.alt: Graph of concentration against time; the curve rises steeply at first and then levels off gradually.

C.alt: Graph of concentration against time; a horizontal straight line.

D.alt: Graph of concentration against time; a horizontal line at the start, then a curve falling to the time axis.
